_comment: Experiment 1 rewritten as a JSON experiment: the three-body figure-eight choreography (Moore, 1993; Chenciner & Montgomery, 2000) with Simo's initial conditions in natural units G = m = 1.
name: Three-body figure-eight
description: Validation of VV4 on a periodic orbit with a known exact answer.

time._comment: t_total = duration * unit = 3 orbital periods; dt = t_total / n_steps
